items.headline: Missouri jumps to 14th in AP Top 25; Florida tumbles 8 spots
items.description: Missouri jumped to No. 14 in the AP Top 25 following its rout of Florida, while the Gators dropped eight spots to No. 16 and were replaced by LSU in the top 10.

items.headline: Richard returns in top form, runs for 204 yards in Hoosiers' rout
items.description: Eight days after he limped off with a right ankle injury, Indiana star rusher Turbo Richard burned Rutgers for a career-best 204 yards and a touchdown in the Hoosiers' 47-15 road win.
